method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs and street-name labels
why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 13 covers avenues A-C, sheet 14 covers C-F, so the only shared avenue is C. Both plates print the name in the corridor: sheet 13 'AVE. C OR MECHANIC' at its east edge (x~3180), sheet 14 'AVE. C OR MECHANIC' at its west edge (x~125). Address runs pin the block: sheet 13's west frontage of Mechanic reads 2704 2706 2708 2710 2712 2714 (27th-28th block) then 2802 2804 ... 2828 in the 28th-29th block of Shipper's Press (block 628); sheet 14's east frontage of the same avenue reads 2701 2703 2705 2707 2709 2711 ... 2727, with the 28th St run 302 304 306 308 turning the corner. One avenue west on sheet 13 is 'AVE. B OR STRAND' (x~2171, drafted 80' wide, 242 px) and one avenue east on sheet 14 is 'AVE. D OR MARKET' (x~1133), neither shared. Detection's candidates (13: 2566/1549/532; 14: 422/1445/2469) are all offset ~615 px west of the real avenue centres and were discarded. Positions taken as the mid-line of the 70' corridor: sheet 13 west street line 3076 + 106; sheet 14 east street line 236 - 106 (70' = 212 px at this plate scale, confirmed by Ave D faces 1027/1239 on sheet 14).
